title: New speech by Julia Leung: Keynote address at ASIFMA’s Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference
html:
Ms Julia Leung delivered a speech, titled “Project Liquidity: Engineering the Market Plumbing that Unlocks Capital Flows for Hong Kong", at the Asia Securities Industry & Financial Markets Association’s (ASIFMA) Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference. It is now posted on the SFC website.

For reference, please note that all published speeches and synopses can be found at the “Published resources > Speeches” section of the SFC website.

End
